d: Archival Assistant Manager designs and implements storage methodology of archival documents so that data management, access, preservation and further retrieval is streamlined corresponding to the requirements of individual departments and ensure procedures are complied with ASG standards. The responsibilities includes:
Establish the customized data management system relevant to the type of data pertaining to each department.
Design the customized storage facility intended to streamline the archival work.
Coordinate with department heads of all ASG entities in order to initiate professional archival of the documents.
Create and maintain accessible, retrievable computer archives and databases, incorporating current advances in electric information storage technology.
Analyze various methods to identify the latest methodology to implement faster, safer and error free data population.
Design the classification and categorization of documents in order to maintain a secure, confidential, organized and accessible Data Management System.
Supervise the transfer of documents from various departments to archive record center upon receiving the request and further approval from authorities.
Create record history for documents “to and from” the archive record center.
Control access to confidential information and recommend codes of practice and procedures for accessing records/files.
Apply adequate pest control and storage methods.
Coordinate with health and safety sections in order to maintain valid commercial licenses.
Update all department heads with the current list of their records on a periodic basis.
Assist in the evaluation of back log scanning project and shortlisting of vendors.
Establish the design, configuration, budget, management report and conduct testing with the finalized vendor to initialize the project.
Coordinate with IT to procure and install hardware/networking for the project ensuring maintenance of bandwidth for faster uploads.
Supervise the PR creation for all relevant purchases and follow up on the same in order to minimize any delays.
Ensure that daily scanning volume is delivered in a timely manner.
Control the troubleshooting aspects during the project and escalate issues in a prompt manner.
Prepare document retention policy in consultation with department heads and Legal Department.
Prepare all relevant documents, obtain approvals and coordinate with external vendors to ensure effective and secure data disposal.
Archive retrieved documents by using appropriate hardware/software tools.
Check and locate the requested documents from the Archive section having prior approval from the Senior Group Manager, Administration.
Prepare necessary documents and approvals for all disposed documents.
Ensure that financial, legal and administrative requirements and regulations are dealt with for all data archival and disposal.
Carry out the responsibilities of the ISO Management Representative.
q: Educational Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor Degree (12th Standard + 3 years or 4 years degree) or equivalent and 6 years of experience or Diploma in Administration (12th Standard + 2 or 3 years Diploma) or equivalent and 2 years of additional managerial experience.
Linguistic Abilities: English and Arabic is a must.

d: End-to-End Traceability: Lead the team in tracing transaction flows from the API Gateway (API Connect) through the Enterprise Service Bus (ACE) to the backend Microservices (Spring Boot).
Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Spearhead deep-dive investigations into middleware failures, such as message losses in MQ, synchronization errors in ACE, or JVM crashes in Spring Boot.
Platform Governance: Oversee the stability of integration components running on Red Hat OpenShift, ensuring optimal resource (CPU/Memory) allocation and pod scaling.
Security Enforcement: Manage and troubleshoot security protocols, including Mutual TLS (mTLS), OAuth2, and JWE/JWS within the integration layer.
q: Integration Platforms: Mastery of IBM CP4I (specifically ACE, MQ, and API Connect).
Development Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Java and Spring Boot (Spring Integration, Spring Cloud).
Containerization: Expert-level proficiency in Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
Protocols & Standards: Expert understanding of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, AMQP, and MQTT.
Monitoring Tools: Hands-on experience with IBM Instana, Dynatrace, or Prometheus/Grafana.

r: App Connect Enterprise (ACE): Troubleshoot message flows, ESQL logic errors, and adapter connectivity issues (SAP, Database, File).
IBM MQ: Manage queue managers, resolve channel retries, and investigate dead-letter queues or message persistence issues.
API Connect: Resolve issues related to API definitions, security policies, and Gateway (DataPower) latency.
Performance Tuning: Analyze JVM thread dumps and heap dumps to resolve memory leaks or high CPU utilization in microservices.
Connectivity Debugging: Troubleshoot Spring Boot integration with databases (JPA/Hibernate) and external messaging systems (JMS/Kafka).

d: We’re looking for a Demand Planner to join the team and focus on growing our own Grocery
Store “Talabat Mart”, which is the region’s first cloud store concept offering 30-minute delivery
of groceries at hypermarket prices. Launched in Kuwait and UAE, the service is
Responsible for ensuring we have the correct inventory at the stores (No OOS or OVS) by analyzing the current inventory status and updating the ordering parameters.
Daily monitoring of stock movement, running report of daily inventory adjustment.

Maintaining parameters of the replenishment model and making sure it is accurately input into the system, including lead times, reorder point, economic order quantities, suppliers minimum order quantities, etc.
Preparing demand forecasts and initiating ordering to the stores and tracking receipt of such orders
Managing the relevant inventory in coordination with the Category Managers
Ensuring timely and accurate analysis and reporting of inventory and purchase forecast
Dispatching orders to suppliers and ensuring proper tracking
Liaising with suppliers for improving collaborative forecasting planning and replenishment
Ensuring maintenance of appropriate and accurate records of in-stock and inventory position are kept
q: You have at least 4+ years of experience in Demand Planning
Strong knowledge of the fundamentals of demand planning, as well as the ability to work on demand forecasting from A-Z
Experience in FMCG in demand planning and replenishment is a must
Experience in Warehouse management or 3PL partner relation is a must
You are very detail-oriented, structured and know how to prioritize - you consider yourself as someone who delivers solutions and not bottlenecks to be solved.
You are able to interact with senior-level executives and can manage the expectations of multiple stakeholders.
You are someone energized by the unknown and look forward to learning each day on the job.
You have excellent analytical and communication skills, and always like to be hands-on with several tools.
Additionally, you have robust interpersonal and intercultural skills. You can inspire several teams and stakeholders to rally behind a mission.
Language skills: Fluent English and Arabi
